tagline: Practical yet deeply spiritual, Don Paolo adapts ancient wisdom to modern needs
bio: Don Paolo ministers to the Arsenal district of Castello, where Venice's technical heart beats strongest. A former ship's chaplain who sailed with merchant fleets, Paolo understands the unique spiritual needs of craftsmen and engineers. His parish encompasses the Arsenal's workshops, where he blesses new projects and provides consciousness guidance to the technical minds building Venice's future.
